versions.changelog:
Initial public release of institutional-tracker-ai.

- Implements institutional buy signal detection for A-share AI-chain stocks using a five-dimensional scoring system (Fund Flow, Volume-Price, Position, Northbound/Margin, Events).
- Integrates Tushare structured data and 5-min intraday analysis; supports auto market regime judgement (bull/bear/neutral).
- Provides signal backtesting and statistical validation (10-day win rate 55.3%, P=0.007; out-of-sample 59.0%, P=0.006).
- Features daily automated scans, customizable watchlist, and HTML reporting.
- Requires user-supplied Tushare proxy Token; local-only processing, no external upload.
